[CVPR 2025 Highlight] InterMimic: Towards Universal Whole-Body Control for Physics-Based Human-Object Interactions

InterDiff: Generating 3D Human-Object Interactions with Physics-Informed Diffusion --> InterMimic: Towards Universal Whole-Body Control for Physics-Based Human-Object Interactions Sirui Xu   Hung Yu Ling   Yu-Xiong Wang   Liang-Yan Gui   University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Electronic Arts CVPR 2025 Highlight 🏆 ## 🏠 Overview > **InterMimic** features **one** unified policy, spanning **diverse full-body interactions** with **dynamic, heterogeneous objects**—and it works out-of-the-box for both **SMPL-X** and **Unitree G1** humanoids. ## 📹 Demo ## 🔥 News - **[2026-02-09]** 🚀 Multi-GPU training support is here! - **[2025-12-17]** 🚀 Isaac Gym checkpoints are compatible with IsaacLab inference?! Check out the newly released implementation. - **[2025-12-15]** IsaacLab support is underway! Data replay is ready—more coming in the next release ☕️ - **[2025-12-07]** 🚀 Release a data conversion pipeline for bringing [InterAct](https://github.com/wzyabcas/InterAct) into simulation. The processing code is available in the [InterAct repository](https://github.com/wzyabcas/InterAct). - **[2025-06-10]** Release the instruction for the student policy inference. - **[2025-06-03]** Initial release of PSI and the processed data. Next release: teacher policy inference for [dynamics-aware retargeting](InterAct/OMOMO_retarget), and student policy inference. - **[2025-05-26]** It's been a while! The student policy training pipeline has been released! The PSI and other data construction pipelines will follow soon. - **[2025-04-18]** Release a checkpoint with high‑fidelity physics and enhanced contact precision. - **[2025-04-11]** The training code for teacher policies is live—try training your own policy! - **[2025-04-05]** We're excited by the overwhelming interest in humanoid robot support and are ahead of schedule in open-sourcing our Unitree-G1 integration—starting with a small demo with support for G1 with its original three-finger dexterous hands. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：InterMimic 以物理信息扩散模型（InterDiff）生成的人-物交互运动为先验，在仿真中通过强化学习训练一个统一的全身控制策略（teacher-student 蒸馏式流程，PSI 物理状态初始化 + 动力学感知重定向数据），使同一策略同时驱动 SMPL-X 人体模型与 Unitree G1 人形机器人完成对动态异构物体的全身交互。


# 一、动机

> 现有基于物理的人-物交互（HOI）方法通常针对单一/固定物体类别、特定动作或单一身体形态训练专用策略，缺乏一个能对动态、异构物体通用的全身控制策略，也几乎没有验证此类策略能否直接迁移到真实人形机器人上。


# 二、方法

> InterMimic 以物理信息扩散模型（InterDiff）生成的人-物交互运动为先验，在仿真中通过强化学习训练一个统一的全身控制策略（teacher-student 蒸馏式流程，PSI 物理状态初始化 + 动力学感知重定向数据），使同一策略同时驱动 SMPL-X 人体模型与 Unitree G1 人形机器人完成对动态异构物体的全身交互。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 1) CVPR 2025 Highlight，用『一个统一策略』覆盖了与动态、异构物体的多样化全身交互，而非每类物体/动作单独训练；2) 同一策略开箱即用地同时支持 SMPL-X 与 Unitree G1 两种本体（含 G1 原装三指灵巧手），验证了跨本体迁移；3) 工程上开源了 PSI 数据构建、teacher/student 策略训练与推理、InterAct 数据转换管线、高保真物理与接触精度 checkpoint，并已支持 IsaacLab 推理与多 GPU 训练（2025-04 至 2026-02 持续更新）。摘要中未给出量化指标（如成功率/跟踪误差的具体数值），需查阅正文。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限在于整个流程依赖仿真中的物理先验与 RL 训练，扩散先验的质量和重定向数据覆盖度决定策略上限，且 G1 上的 sim-to-real 仍待真机验证；对课题的启发是：『大规模人-物交互动捕数据 → 物理跟踪策略 → 跨本体重定向』这条路径可作为具身人形全身操作（whole-body manipulation）的通用范式，且 teacher-student 蒸馏 + 域随机化是实现统一策略与硬件迁移的关键手段。
